bio.text: LaMonica McIver represents New Jersey's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and sits on the Small Business and Homeland Security committees.
She is a former Newark City Council president and nonprofit founder.
She was born and raised in Newark's Central Ward, where she still lives with her family.
She attended Newark public schools and earned an undergraduate degree from Bloomfield College and a master's degree from Seton Hall University.
